subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
If input analog voltage change, then which of the 
following is not true? 
 
(a) Conversion time charges in counter type ADC 
in general. 
 
(b) Conversion time charges in dual slope type 
ADC in general. 
 
(c) Conversion time charges in SAR type ADC in 
general. 
 
(d) Conversion time remains unchanged in SAR 
type ADC.

options.text: Conversion time charges in counter type ADC
Conversion time charges in dual slope type
Conversion time charges in SAR type ADC in
Conversion time remains unchanged in SAR

explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-14 (Digital Electronics Practice Sheet 14).
